title: Glastonbury Tor's Dawn Spectacle: Rainbow Appears Amid Storm Warnings
text: Glastonbury Tor's Dawn Spectacle: Rainbow Appears Amid Storm Warnings Photographer Michelle Cowbourne's debut sunrise image at Glastonbury Tor showcases St Michael's Church under a vibrant sky and a transient orange rainbow. The sighting arrived just as Storm Austen threatened Somerset with strong winds, prompting regional warnings and travel advisories. At dawn on Thursday, October 22, photographer Michelle Cowbourne captured an extraordinary image of Glastonbury Tor that showcases both the monument's historic grandeur and a fleeting natural spectacle. The photograph features St Michael's Church, which sits atop the ancient Somerset mound, framed against a dramatic sky painted in deep reds and blues. A vivid orange rainbow arches perfectly across the church's central axis, creating a striking contrast with the morning light.Photographer Captures Rainbow After RainCowbourne explained that the picture was taken immediately after a heavy downpour: as the sun emerged, western clouds rolled in, the rain began just as the horizon cleared, and the sky lit up with an orange glow to the left of the scene and darker tones to the right. The rainbow appeared briefly before the clouds moved away, and Cowbourne noted the difficulty of capturing it without getting soaked.The same photographer was also able to capture the rainbow from inside St Michael's Church. In that frame the rising sun casts a warm yellow glow across the hilltop and throughout the surrounding town, underscoring the pastoral beauty of the area. These stunning images are particularly timely as Storm Austen approaches Somerset.Meteorological reports forecast powerful gusts of 50 to 60 miles per hour from Thursday night into Friday, with some exposed coastal locations experiencing winds exceeding 70 miles per hour. The Met Office has issued warnings across southern England and south Wales, anticipates potential travel disruptions, damage to buildings, and power outages.Amber Wind Warning Issued For DevonIn response to the storm, forecasters have issued an amber wind warning for Devon and Cornwall from 1 a.m. to 10 a.m. tomorrow, highlighting the risk of 60 to 70‑mile‑per‑hour gusts and isolated areas that could see winds of 80 miles per hour. Homeowners in the region should prepare for possible power cutbacks, while coastal communities are advised to be cautious of large waves and beach debris that may endanger life along roads.A yellow warning for wind has been activated for the broader South West, South Wales, and the South Coast of England, effective from midnight to 5 p.m. on Friday. Strong winds are projected to permeate most of southern England on Thursday and Friday, with many exposed zones experiencing gusts of 70 miles per hour or more. These warnings suggest that residents need to secure loose outdoor items, monitor local news for updates, and follow any evacuation notices if conditions worsen.The images captured by Cowbourne not only provide a visual highlight of the region's natural beauty but also serve as a reminder of how dynamic weather patterns can dramatically alter the landscape. As Britain prepares to contend with the coming storm front, the combination of dramatic sunrise, dramatic skies, and the fleeting rainbow at Glastonbury Tor provides a memorable snapshot of the country's resilient spirit amid trying weather conditions.
summary: At dawn on Thursday, October 22, photographer Michelle Cowbourne captured an extraordinary image of Glastonbury Tor that showcases both the monument's historic grandeur and a fleeting natural spectacle. The photograph features St Michael's Church, which sits atop the ancient Somerset mound, framed against a dramatic sky painted in deep reds and blues.
